blurb: Brookside Golf Club offers two daily fee golf courses designed by William P. Bell, located next to the Rose Bowl in Pasadena. Guests can book tee times up to 14 days in advance with a deposit and reservation fee. The club also hosts special events including weddings, corporate meetings, and tournaments.
extraNote: $10 deposit per player required, non-refundable but credited toward green fee at check-in · Reservations may be adjusted once without forfeiting deposit; additional changes require cancellation and rebooking with new deposit · Cancellations must be made 24 hours in advance to avoid cancellation fee equal to reserved green fee · No-shows or short shows subject to no-show fee equal to reserved green fee; no refunds · All prepaid reservations are non-refundable
